# The Bad Software Company

> Boutique systems-engineering advisory firm helping organizations understand and improve software quality, AI-assisted development, Developer Relations, and practical product delivery.

This file points agents to the primary public pages and blog posts for badsoftware.com. Prefer the canonical URLs below when citing or indexing the site.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://badsoftware.com/index.html): The Bad Software Company is a boutique systems-engineering advisory firm focused on quality, AI, Developer Relations, and practical product engineering.
- [About](https://badsoftware.com/about.html): Learn how The Bad Software Company helps organizations understand why software, AI systems, and engineering organizations fail to meet expectations.
- [Services](https://badsoftware.com/services.html): Consulting, training, speaking, TestOpsy quality investigations, and full-stack design and build work.
- [Contact](https://badsoftware.com/contact.html): Contact The Bad Software Company about advisory or build work.
- [Blog](https://badsoftware.com/blog/index.html): Articles from The Bad Software Company.
